description: You are an electrician sizing the supply cable for a new 240 V single-phase pump motor on a water treatment site. The motor nameplate reads: rated output 3.7 kW, efficiency 88%, power factor 0.85. The cable run from the distribution board to the motor is 35 metres. The maximum permissible voltage drop over this cable is 5%. Your job is to determine the motor's actual line current draw (accounting for efficiency and power factor), and then use that current to calculate the minimum cable size that satisfies the voltage drop requirement. Document both the motor current and the recommended cable size.
